translation.name: Kazuwamgbani ka savu n Tsikimba n aɓon a ɗa a ɗanga̱sai a kazuwamgbani ka cau

book.name: Kagali ka Ibirahi
book.title: Ukanikorongi Ubana a Asu u Kagali ka Ibirahi

content: Kashila̱ ka yanka tsu ta̱ kazuwamgbani ka tsa fuɗa tsa uwa asu u uwunvuga u ne. Adama a nala u ka̱na̱ ta̱ ya dem u kirana, tsa̱ra̱ uza u namba u uwa pini wa.
Tsu pana ta̱ akani yi tyoku ɗa aza a Isaraꞌila a panai. Shegai a ꞌyuwain upityanangu a ili iꞌya a panai, akani yi tani a ɓa̱nga̱ le wa.
A̱tsa aza ɗa tsu a pityanangi ɗa koshi tsa uwa asu u uwunvuga u ne. Aza ɗa kpam bawu a pityanangi, Kashila̱ ka dana ta̱,

content.text: “N yan ta̱ upan kpam n tsinai,
‘A ka uwa asu u uwunvuga u va̱ wa, ko kenu.’ ”

content: U dana ta̱ nala ko an u wokoi u kotso ɗe ufoɓuso a asu u uwunvuga u ne a aꞌayin a ɗa u yain likimba.
A Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ u yan ta̱ kadyanshi a kaci ka kain ka shindere ka aꞌayin a shindere, u da: “Kain ka shindere ka Kashila̱ ka wunvugai a manyan ma ne gba̱.”
Tsu yan ta̱ dem ka̱neshi an u doki u danai a asu u roku, “Ama a na a ka uwa asu u uwunvuga u va̱ wa!”
Aza a kagita̱ a ɗa panai akani yi a tsa̱ra̱ asu u uwunvuga vi wa, kpaci a pityanangu wa. Shegai mayun ɗa ama roku a ka uwa ta̱ asu u uwunvuga vi.

Adama a nala Kashila̱ ka zuwai aꞌayin a roku a ɗa ama a ka uwa asu u wunvuga u ne, kpam aꞌayin a nala yi a ɗa u isa̱i “Ara.” A ɓa̱ra̱kpa̱ ta̱ cika an Kashila̱ ka danai nala kahu u tuwa̱ u dansa a una̱ u Dawuda, an u danai,

content.text: “Vu pana baci kala̱ga̱tsu ka Kashila̱ ara,

content: Uyamba u Kaꞌana† u ɗa Joshuwa† tonoi n ama a uwai vi, u ɗa a asu u uwunvuga u savu u na vi wa. A da baci u ɗa, Kashila̱ ka̱ri ka yan kadyanshi a kaci ka kain ka uwunvuga ka roku ka ka tuwa̱ wa.
Nala u wenike ta̱ aꞌayin a uwunvuga u ama a Kashila̱ kotsu a rawa wa. Aꞌayin a uwunvuga a na, aꞌa̱ ta̱ ucun u uwunvuga u ɗa Kashila̱ ka wunvugai a kain ka Ashibi.
Uza ɗa baci dem u uwai asu u uwunvuga u Kashila̱, wa wunvuga ta̱ aꞌayin a ɗa baci u kotsoi manyan ma ne tyoku ɗa Kashila̱ ka wunvugai an u kotsoi uyan likimba.
A̱sa̱ka̱i tsu ma̱tsa̱i tyoku ufuɗa u tsunu tsa̱ra̱ tsu uwa asu u uwunvuga u ne, kotsu uza u te u tsunu u rukpa̱, tyoku ɗa a yain an a ꞌyuwain upana wa.

Akani a Kashila̱ aꞌa̱ ta̱ tyoku u ili iꞌya iꞌa̱ri n uma kpam iꞌa̱ri n ucira. A la ta̱ burundu u kulya u ɗa wa̱ri n una̱ u kulya u re. A tsu ɓatsa ta̱ kapashi ka tsunu ka ka̱ri n uma a ɓatsa kpam kulu ka ka bana a asu u Kashila̱. A tsu ɓatsa ta̱ dem a mere ma ala̱tu n mere ma aꞌungu a atele a tsunu. A tsu wutukpa̱ ta̱ ili iꞌya tsa ciga tsu sokongu a kateshe; wata, ili iꞌya tsu tsu yawunsa n iꞌya tsu tsu ciga.
Uza wa̱ la wa sokongu ili a likimba aku Kashila̱ ka kpa̱ɗa̱ iꞌya uwene wa. U tsu wene ta̱ ili tyoku ɗa iꞌa̱ri. Aya Kashila̱ ka u ka̱na̱i tsu tonuko gba̱ ili iꞌya tsu yain.
Tsu lyai kapala n uɓa̱na̱ n ugbami ili iꞌya tsu da tsu pityanangi n iꞌya. Tsu yain nala kpaci tsa̱ ta̱ n Magono ma Aɗara̱kpi, Yesu Maku ma Kashila̱, uza ɗa u banai a zuba.
U reve ta̱ an tsu sorukpoi. Kala̱pa̱nsi ka ma̱tsa̱i ka zuwa yi unyushi u cingi a ure u ɗa baci dem wa ma̱tsa̱ u zuwa tsu tsu yain unyushi u cingi, shegai Kawauwi ka yan unyushi u cingi wa.

Adama a nala a̱sa̱ka̱ tsu tuwa̱i a asu u Kashila̱ bawu uwonvo. Aya uza ɗa u yain ili i shinga ubana a asu u ama. Aꞌayin a ɗa baci dem tsu yain nala, wa yanka tsu ta̱ tsishinga kpam u ɓa̱nga̱ tsu aꞌayin a ɗa tsa ciga u ɓa̱nga̱ tsu.
